critique.evidence: The paradoxical hero—“The signature is valid. The intent was stolen.”—paired with cyan/red forensic paths from recorded intent and page evidence to a verified payment creates a distinctive, demo-worthy visual thesis rather than a generic dashboard. The concept remains recognizable across viewports, though mobile removes the connecting paths and reduces the evidence trail to a conventional stack of cards.
critique.fix: Preserve the signature-versus-intent split on mobile with compact vertical cyan/red rails or animated trace lines connecting the evidence cards to the final contradiction, so the screen’s signature visual idea survives every viewport.
